request_state.desc: Darmons program with hypergeometric motives for three independent exponents: attaching rank-2 or rank-4 motives H(A^x, B^y, C^z) across all (x,y,z) simultaneously to bypass instance-by-instance modularity.
request_state.mechanism: Global motivic L-functions and rigid local systems
